publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp 0.4.0 adds Move in, a reviewed import of support history (conversations, contacts, tags, saved replies and articles) that keeps original timestamps and publication state and starts nothing; resolution feedback and Reports with workspace-calendar response, resolution and satisfaction figures and formula-safe CSV; Connections, with scoped workspace API tokens, signed webhook events and Slack delivery; and the local rer path (node scripts/rer.mjs install, setup and dev) with sign-in through a local development outbox. Native passwords, owners and data are kept. Before the updated Worker serves traffic, back up D1, R2 and private settings and apply the ten listed additive migrations, 0110_move_in.sql to 119_local_portability.sql, in order; earlier migrations stay unchanged. Upgrading from 0.3.x also means Node.js 22.20.0 and the rer commands; OPERATIONS.md lists every step. Known limits: accessibility is on a confirmed owner HOLD and no WCAG conformance is claimed; backups and archives cover D1 and R2 but not Durable Object storage, and full portable-storage fidelity is not established; hosted operating costs are unmeasured, and timed activation and paid-provider execution are not qualified; imports and connections are qualified with synthetic fixtures only, without real vendor exports or live Slack; no hosted installation, compliance or FedRAMP qualification is claimed. The hosted service at app.happytohelp.com is separate legacy production and is not part of this release.
